title: PCSO lotto results: No winners of major games; Ultra Lotto jackpot hits P575.9 million
summary: The jackpot for the Ultra Lotto 6/58 game is inching closer to P600 million, but there were no winners of either of the major lotto games played on Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026.

blocks.text: The jackpot for the Ultra Lotto 6/58 game is inching closer to P600 million, but there were no winners of either of the major lotto games played on Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026.

No bettor chose the winning combination of 05-51-44-55-32-21 for the Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot, which has risen to P575,944,129.09. The Ultra Lotto prize has not been won since 10 bettors split the P76.3-million pot in May.
There was also no winner of the Superlotto 6/49 prize, which is now at P126,805,240.84. The winning combination was 12-38-29-25-44-39.
